name: Shinju no Toiki
source:
Main character receives a letter from his sister saying that she is forced to work at some mansion for three years to return father's debt. Main character never heard of the debt and the debt company, so he leaves the house and hurries to the rescue.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到妹妹寄来的一封信。信中说，为了偿还父亲的债务，她被迫在某座宅邸工作三年。主角从未听说过这笔债务，也不知道信中提到的讨债公司，于是立刻离家，赶去营救妹妹。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
